basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old hobbyist from Asheville, NC, exploring Reddit to learn more about my new passion: rock tumbling. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to spend my evenings and weekends online. I love cats and have a soft spot for quirky mobile games. I'm single and enjoy spending time outdoors or visiting local art galleries. On Reddit, I usually browse late at night, around 10 PM to midnight, after winding down from the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm new to rock tumbling and have been absorbing information from online communities and YouTube tutorials. My background in graphic design gives me an eye for aesthetics, which I apply to my tumbling projects.
